name: select
title: Select 下拉选择
description: 从一组固定选项中选择一个值，选项收在下拉面板里。

whenToUse: 选项超过 5 个且只能选一个

whenNotToUse.case: 选项 2–5 个且需要一眼看全

accessibility: 保留 Bits UI 的键盘操作（方向键、回车、Esc）
用 Field 提供可见标签
responsive: 窄屏下触发器占满宽度
选项很多时面板内部滚动

files.content:
# Select 设计规范

- 用于从一组固定选项中选值：2–5 个且需要一眼看全的选项用 Radio Group，需要搜索大量选项用 Popover + Command，触发操作而不是选值用 Dropdown Menu；需要原生行为（移动端系统选择器）时用 Native Select。
- `Select.Root` 必须设 `type="single"` 或 `type="multiple"`；值是字符串（多选为字符串数组），用 `bind:value` 绑定。
- 把选项数组传给 `Select.Root` 的 `items`，触发器里用 `<Select.Value placeholder="…" />` 显示选中项的文字；表单提交时设 `name`。
- `Select.Trigger` 设 `id` 并用 `Field.Label for={id}` 关联（检查规则 `valar/input-label`）。错误用 `aria-invalid="true"`，说明用 `aria-describedby` 关联。焦点提示绘制在边界内。
- 尺寸用 `Select.Trigger` 的 `size` 属性（`sm`、`default`、`settings`），宽度用 `w-*` 档位；不要用 `class` 改高度或圆角。
- 常规和设置触发器同为 30 px 高，两者共用尺寸档位。小尺寸高 28 px，默认主题圆角为 8 px。浮层圆角 12 px，选项最小高度 32 px。设置区有独立主题时，用 `appearance="settings"` 的内容，并让 Portal 挂在该主题容器内。
- 选项多时用 `Select.Group` 与 `Select.GroupHeading` 分组，组间用装饰性的 `Select.Separator`。每个 `Select.Item` 同时设 `value` 和 `label`。长选项可在视觉上截断，保留完整可访问名称。
- 方向键移动高亮，Enter 确认，Escape 关闭并归焦。禁用选项会被跳过，单个禁用选项和整项禁用分别设置。多选中的当前选值以勾选标记，多选、禁用和错误样式采用 Valar 规则。

<script lang="ts">
	import type { Snippet } from "svelte";

	let {
		children,
	}: {
		to?: string | Element | DocumentFragment | null;
		disabled?: boolean;
		children?: Snippet;
	} = $props();
</script>

{@render children?.()}

{#snippet render({ props })}
{/snippet}

<script lang="ts">
	import { SelectTrigger as SdkTrigger, type SelectController } from "@ui-sdk/svelte/select";
	import IconPlaceholder from "$lib/components/icon-placeholder/icon-placeholder.svelte";
	import type { StyleProperties } from "svelte-toolbelt";
	import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
	import type { HTMLButtonAttributes } from "svelte/elements";
	import { cn } from "$UTILS$.js";
	import { bindElementRef, toStyleString } from "./context.js";

	let {
		ref = $bindable(null),
		class: className,
		style,
		children,
		size = "default",
		disabled,
		controller,
		"aria-labelledby": ariaLabelledBy,
		...restProps
	}: Omit<HTMLButtonAttributes, "style" | "children"> & {
		ref?: HTMLButtonElement | HTMLElement | null;
		style?: StyleProperties | string | null;
		size?: "sm" | "default" | "settings";
		disabled?: boolean;
		controller?: SelectController<string, boolean>;
		children?: Snippet;
	} = $props();

	const refAttachment = bindElementRef<HTMLButtonElement>((el) => {
		ref = el;
	});
</script>

<SdkTrigger
	{disabled}
	{controller}
	aria-labelledby={ariaLabelledBy}
	data-slot="select-trigger"
	data-size={size}
	class={cn(
		"[--valar-select-trigger-bg:white] [--valar-select-trigger-hover:lch(95%_.5_282)] [--valar-select-trigger-ink:lch(20%_1_282)] [--valar-select-trigger-edge:lch(86.5%_0_282)] dark:[--valar-select-trigger-bg:lch(13.861%_1.139_272)] dark:[--valar-select-trigger-hover:lch(18.49%_1.525_272)] dark:[--valar-select-trigger-ink:lch(90.826%_1.425_272)] dark:[--valar-select-trigger-edge:lch(38.032%_2.38_272)] gap-1.5 rounded-md border border-transparent bg-[color:var(--settings-control,var(--valar-select-trigger-bg))] py-0 pr-2 pl-2.5 text-[13px] text-[color:var(--settings-control-text,var(--valar-select-trigger-ink))] shadow-[var(--settings-control-shadow,0_0_0_.5px_var(--valar-select-trigger-edge)_inset)] transition-colors select-none data-placeholder:text-muted-foreground enabled:hover:bg-[color:var(--settings-control-hover,var(--valar-select-trigger-hover))] data-open:bg-[color:var(--settings-control-hover,var(--valar-select-trigger-hover))] focus-visible:outline-1 focus-visible:-outline-offset-1 focus-visible:outline-solid focus-visible:outline-[color:var(--settings-focus,lch(46%_70_267))] dark:focus-visible:outline-[color:var(--settings-focus,lch(48%_72_267))] aria-invalid:border-destructive aria-invalid:ring-1 aria-invalid:ring-inset aria-invalid:ring-destructive/20 focus-visible:aria-invalid:outline-destructive dark:focus-visible:aria-invalid:outline-destructive motion-reduce:transition-none data-[size=default]:h-7.5 data-[size=settings]:h-7.5 data-[size=sm]:h-7 [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-3.5 flex w-fit max-w-full min-w-0 items-center justify-between whitespace-nowrap outline-none disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 *:data-[slot=select-value]:min-w-0 *:data-[slot=select-value]:overflow-hidden [&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:shrink-0",
		className
	)}
	style={toStyleString(style)}
	{...restProps}
>
	{#snippet render({ props, state })}
		{@const sdkLabelledBy = props["aria-labelledby"] as string | undefined}
		{@const resolvedLabelledBy =
			ariaLabelledBy ?? (sdkLabelledBy?.endsWith("-label") ? undefined : sdkLabelledBy)}
		<button
			{...props}
			{...refAttachment}
			aria-labelledby={resolvedLabelledBy}
			data-state={state.open ? "open" : "closed"}
		>
			{@render children?.()}
			<IconPlaceholder
				lucide="ChevronDownIcon"
				tabler="IconSelector"
				hugeicons="UnfoldMoreIcon"
				phosphor="CaretDownIcon"
				remixicon="RiArrowDownSLine"
				class="text-muted-foreground size-3.5 pointer-events-none"
			/>
		</button>
	{/snippet}
</SdkTrigger>
{#snippet render({ props, state })} {#if children} {@render children()} {:else} {state.placeholder ? (placeholder ?? "") : state.label} {/if} {/snippet}

<script lang="ts">
	import {
		Select as SdkSelect,
		type SelectController,
		type SelectDismissReason,
		type SelectOpenChangeReason,
		type SelectValueChangeReason,
	} from "@ui-sdk/svelte/select";
	import type { ChangeDetails, DismissAttemptDetails } from "@ui-sdk/core";
	import type { ListData } from "@ui-sdk/core/select";
	import type { Snippet } from "svelte";

	export type SelectItemData = {
		value: string;
		label?: string;
		disabled?: boolean;
	};

	type SingleProps = {
		type?: "single";
		multiple?: false;
		value?: string;
		defaultValue?: string;
		onValueChange?: (value: string, details?: ChangeDetails<SelectValueChangeReason>) => void;
	};

	type MultipleProps = {
		type: "multiple";
		multiple?: true;
		value?: string[];
		defaultValue?: string[];
		onValueChange?: (value: string[], details?: ChangeDetails<SelectValueChangeReason>) => void;
	};

	let {
		type = "single",
		multiple: multipleProp,
		open = $bindable(),
		defaultOpen,
		value = $bindable(),
		defaultValue,
		items,
		name,
		form,
		autoComplete,
		disabled,
		readOnly,
		required,
		placeholder,
		loop = true,
		virtualFocus = true,
		modal,
		presentation,
		controller,
		dismissible,
		container,
		// Accepted for Bits UI compatibility.
		allowDeselect: _allowDeselect,
		scrollAlignment: _scrollAlignment,
		onValueChange,
		onOpenChange,
		onOpenChangeComplete,
		onDismissAttempt,
		children,
	}: (SingleProps | MultipleProps) & {
		open?: boolean;
		defaultOpen?: boolean;
		items?: SelectItemData[] | ListData<string>;
		name?: string;
		form?: string;
		autoComplete?: string;
		disabled?: boolean;
		readOnly?: boolean;
		required?: boolean;
		placeholder?: string;
		loop?: boolean;
		virtualFocus?: boolean;
		modal?: boolean | "pointer";
		presentation?: "auto" | "popover" | "sheet";
		controller?: SelectController<string, boolean>;
		dismissible?: boolean;
		container?: Element | DocumentFragment | null;
		allowDeselect?: boolean;
		scrollAlignment?: "nearest" | "center";
		onOpenChange?: (open: boolean, details?: ChangeDetails<SelectOpenChangeReason>) => void;
		onOpenChangeComplete?: (open: boolean) => void;
		onDismissAttempt?: (details: DismissAttemptDetails<SelectDismissReason>) => void;
		children?: Snippet;
	} = $props();

	const isMultiple = $derived(multipleProp ?? type === "multiple");

	const sdkValue = $derived.by(() => {
		if (isMultiple) {
			return Array.isArray(value) ? value : undefined;
		}
		if (value === undefined) return undefined;
		return value === "" ? null : (value as string);
	});

	const sdkDefaultValue = $derived.by(() => {
		if (defaultValue === undefined) return undefined;
		if (isMultiple) {
			return Array.isArray(defaultValue) ? defaultValue : [];
		}
		return defaultValue === "" ? null : (defaultValue as string);
	});

	function handleValueChange(
		next: string | string[] | null,
		details: ChangeDetails<SelectValueChangeReason>
	) {
		if (isMultiple) {
			const arr = Array.isArray(next) ? next : [];
			(
				onValueChange as
					| ((value: string[], details?: ChangeDetails<SelectValueChangeReason>) => void)
					| undefined
			)?.(arr, details);
			if (!details.canceled) {
				value = arr;
			}
		} else {
			const str = typeof next === "string" ? next : "";
			(
				onValueChange as
					| ((value: string, details?: ChangeDetails<SelectValueChangeReason>) => void)
					| undefined
			)?.(str, details);
			if (!details.canceled) {
				value = str;
			}
		}
	}

	function handleOpenChange(next: boolean, details: ChangeDetails<SelectOpenChangeReason>) {
		onOpenChange?.(next, details);
		if (!next && !details.canceled && details.reason === "escape-key") {
			details.event?.stopPropagation();
		}
		if (!details.canceled && open !== undefined) {
			open = next;
		}
	}
</script>

<SdkSelect
	multiple={isMultiple}
	bind:open
	{defaultOpen}
	value={sdkValue as never}
	defaultValue={sdkDefaultValue as never}
	items={items as ListData<string> | undefined}
	{name}
	{form}
	{autoComplete}
	{disabled}
	{readOnly}
	{required}
	{placeholder}
	{loop}
	{virtualFocus}
	{modal}
	{presentation}
	{controller}
	{dismissible}
	{container}
	onValueChange={handleValueChange as never}
	onOpenChange={handleOpenChange}
	{onOpenChangeComplete}
	{onDismissAttempt}
>
	{@render children?.()}
</SdkSelect>
